items.title: 5.4.1 Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (London dispersion forces) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4.1, printed pages 98-100, with Quick Check 5.2 and answers.

blocks.title: Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole force
blocks.text: Ek instantaneous (sirf ek pal ka) dipole aur us se bane induced (paida kiye gaye) dipole ke darmiyan momentary (pal bhar ki) force of attraction (kashish) ko instantaneous dipole-induced dipole force kehte hain.
Non-polar compounds ke molecules ke darmiyan sirf yehi forces hoti hain. In forces ki strength (taqat) neeche diye gaye factors (asar karne wali cheezon) par depend karti hai.

Compound ka molecular mass (Mᵣ) jitna zyada, id-id forces utni mazboot; aur mass kam to forces kamzor. Wajah: bare atom ya molecule ka electron cloud asani se phail aur khisak (polarise ho) jata hai. Yeh baat halogen aur noble gas families mein nazar aati hai. Halogen family mein upar se neeche size aur polarizability barhti hai, is liye physical state badalti hai: pehle do members (F₂ aur Cl₂) gas hain, bromine liquid aur iodine solid (b.p. = 458 K). Group 18 ki noble gases ke boiling points bhi helium (He) se xenon (Xe) tak barhte hain, jaisa Table 5.1 mein hai.

blocks.caption: Table 5.1 Group 17 aur 18 ke molar masses aur boiling points

blocks.text: Jis molecule ka surface area bara ho, woh paas wale molecule ko zyada jagahon se chhoota (contact karta) hai, is liye us ki forces mazboot hoti hain. Saturated hydrocarbons dekhein: in mein carbon atoms ki chain (zanjeer) hoti hai jis se hydrogen atoms jure hote hain. C₂H₆ aur C₆H₁₄ ki chain ki lambai ka comparison karein: un ke boiling points −88.6 °C aur 68.7 °C hain. Saaf hai ke lambi chain wale molecules mein attraction (kashish) zyada hai, kyunke lambe molecule ki lambai ke saath zyada jagahen hain jahan doosre molecules us se khinch sakte hain. Kuch hydrocarbons ke boiling points Table 5.2 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 5.2 Kuch hydrocarbons ke boiling points aur physical states

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Table 5.2 mein “Isodecane (C₂₀H₄₂)” likhti hai. C₂₀H₄₂ ka sahi naam icosane (eicosane) hai: 20 carbon wali seedhi chain, room temperature par solid. Isodecane decane (C₁₀H₂₂) ka branched isomer hai.

Pentane ke teen isomers ka relative molecular mass (Mᵣ) ek jaisa hai, lekin un ka surface area alag alag hai. Seedhi chain wale pentane (n-pentane) ka surface area sab se bara hai, is liye us ka boiling point bhi teenon mein sab se zyada hai. 2-Methylbutane (isopentane) ka surface area n-pentane se kam magar 2,2-dimethylpropane (neopentane) se zyada hai. Is liye 2-methylbutane mein forces intermediate (darmiyani) hain aur sab se kamzor forces 2,2-dimethylpropane mein hain. Figure 5.2 mein teenon isomers aur un ke boiling points diye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Pink shaklon par teen condensed structural formulas. Pentane (n-pentane): H3C-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3 zigzag chain, b.p. 36.2 degrees C. 2-Methylbutane (iso-pentane): chain H3C-CH-CH2-CH3, doosre carbon par CH3 branch (shaakh), b.p. 28 degrees C. 2,2-Dimethylpropane (neo-pentane): beech wala carbon chaar CH3 groups se juda, compact (gathi hui) shakal, b.p. 9.5 degrees C.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.2: Pentane ke teen isomers ki structure (banawat), surface area aur intermolecular forces alag alag hain (kitab ki Figure 5.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gulabi (pink) shakal har molecule ka bahar wala surface dikhati hai. Seedhi chain (n-pentane) ka surface sab se lamba hai, is liye paas wale molecules se contact zyada aur London forces mazboot: b.p. sab se zyada (36.2 °C). Neo-pentane gend (ball) jaisa gol hai, contact kam, b.p. sab se kam (9.5 °C).

blocks.prompt: a) Petrol ki quality behtar karne ke liye gasoline hisse ke seedhi chain wale hydrocarbons ko branched chain mein badla jata hai. Is ki kya wajah ho sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Branched molecule gol (compact) hota hai, us ka surface area kam hai, is liye London forces kamzor aur boiling point kam hota hai. Aisa fuel asani se vapour ban kar engine mein smoothly (aaram se) jalta hai aur knocking kam hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) CCl₄ aur SiF₄ ke molecules ke darmiyan kaun si forces hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono symmetrical tetrahedral, non-polar molecules hain (bond dipoles ek doosre ko khatam kar dete hain), is liye in ke darmiyan sirf London (id-id) forces hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Misalon ke saath id-id aur pd-pd forces mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: id-id (London) forces electron cloud ki pal bhar ki na-barabari se banti hain aur har molecule mein hoti hain; pd-pd forces sirf polar molecules mein hoti hain jin ka permanent dipole ho.

rows: Instantaneous (pal bhar ke) dipole aur us se bane induced dipole ke darmiyan attraction
Ek polar molecule ke positive end aur doosre ke negative end ke darmiyan attraction
Har molecule mein hoti hain; non-polar molecules mein sirf yehi hoti hain
Sirf polar molecules mein hoti hain jin ka permanent dipole ho
Dipole pal bhar ka hai, banta aur khatam hota rehta hai
Dipole permanent hai, hamesha rehta hai
Mass, size aur surface area barhne se mazboot hoti hain
Molecule ki polarity (dipole) barhne se mazboot hoti hain
Misal: Cl₂, CCl₄, noble gases (He, Ar)

items: London (id-id) force: instantaneous dipole doosre molecule mein dipole paida karta hai; non-polar molecules mein sirf yehi force.
Mass aur size barhe to force mazboot (F₂ gas se I₂ solid; He 4.22 K se Xe 165 K). Surface area barhe to force mazboot (n-pentane 36.2 > isopentane 28 > neopentane 9.5 °C).
